name: Culinary Mysteries
description: Chef Gustavo keeps a key settlement kitchen running. He's blocked on reconstructing an old survival recipe. Help him complete it.

text: Good, another capable cook. I've recovered an old ration recipe
that I've been trying to recreate. But it's missing some ingredients.
The recipe calls for a rare Moonlit Mushroom. Would you be able to fetch it for me?
completedText: Have you found the Moonlit Mushroom?
It's crucial to the dish I'm trying to recreate.

hasItemText: Ah, the Moonlit Mushroom! Fantastic! But there's one more thing...
The recipe mentions a 'secret spice'. No one seems to know what it is.
However, old tales speak of a hermit living atop the snowy peaks who
might have knowledge about this. Could you consult him?

text: Chef Gustavo's 'secret spice'? It's not a spice at all!
It's the dried petal of a Frozen Rose, found deep within these mountains.
Retrieve it, and the recipe will be complete.
completedText: The Frozen Rose is a rare flower.
Take care when searching for it.

hasItemText: The Frozen Rose petal! The final ingredient!
Now, watch as I create culinary history...
Thank you, survivor. For your help, I grant you
the Chef's Special Apron. May it aid you in all your culinary endeavors!

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@You have just finished @crimson@Culinary Mysteries@green@. You've been awarded @crimson@2500@green@ Cooking experience and a @crimson@Chef's Special Apron@green@!
